desc: Ideation: select A-block sqrt decomposition with full-block prefix contributions and sparse 2D-difference partial-block handling.
Implement the complete Python solution using offline A-block decomposition, precomputed R_p[r][q], blockSum updates by Y, and optimized corner sum as specified in NEXT.
Verify correctness on samples and edge cases (N=1, K=1, all equal values, X/Y at block boundaries, last partial blocks) and tune block size/corner threshold if needed.
